findings.evidenceJa: 妙に殺気だってる
findings.governingReading: Sakura says Rin is acting strangely murderous or visibly bristling with killing intent.
findings.explanation: The English reduces overt killing intent to a generic intimidating manner.

findings.evidenceJa: 騙し討ちなんてしない
findings.governingReading: Rin says their pact means she will not launch a surprise or treacherous attack.
findings.explanation: The English removes the deceit and surprise that define the prohibited act.

findings.evidenceJa: 言い切ったわね
findings.governingReading: Rin remarks that Sakura has said her claim outright or without qualification.
findings.explanation: The English substitutes a personality judgment for Rin’s reaction to the categorical declaration.

findings.evidenceJa: ボストンバッグ
findings.governingReading: A Boston bag containing Rin’s instruments has been left in the dojo.
findings.explanation: The English removes the concrete type of bag.

findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂
findings.governingReading: Shirou directly addresses Rin by name when asking to pause.
findings.explanation: The English drops the form of address and slightly weakens the interpersonal beat.

findings.highlight: I’m sorry I’m not explaining things to you
findings.evidenceJa: 説明不足で悪かったわね
findings.governingReading: Rin sarcastically apologizes for having given an inadequate explanation.
findings.explanation: The English turns a completed deficiency into a claim that she is not explaining anything.

findings.highlight: I know I’m not normal compared to you
findings.evidenceJa: どうせ、貴方と比べてこっちは普通じゃないわよ
findings.governingReading: Rin petulantly concedes that, compared with Shirou, her side is of course the abnormal one.
findings.explanation: The English loses the dismissive resignation carried by どうせ and recasts it as neutral self-knowledge.

findings.evidenceJa: 出て行けばいいじゃない
findings.governingReading: Rin tells Shirou that if he has complaints he can leave.
findings.explanation: The English adds an unspecified alternate destination.

findings.evidenceJa: 全面的に信頼してる
findings.governingReading: Shirou says he trusts Rin completely.
findings.explanation: The malformed English obscures the force and naturalness of his reassurance.

findings.evidenceJa: 大人しく言うコト聞きなさいよね
findings.governingReading: Rin tells Shirou to behave and do as she says if he has no questions.
findings.explanation: The English replaces obedience to her instructions with physical quietness.

findings.evidenceJa: 再確認する為の宣言
findings.governingReading: Shirou calls the declaration a means of reconfirming that they have long since lost the option of turning back.
findings.explanation: The English changes the declaration’s epistemic function into a generic expression of determination.

findings.highlight: I don’t think I can beat Grandfather
findings.evidenceJa: わたしたちではお爺さまには勝てない
findings.governingReading: Sakura says their group cannot defeat Zouken.
findings.explanation: The English assigns the inability to Sakura alone, changing the scope of her strategic assessment.

findings.highlight: I can’t ignore the shadow either
findings.evidenceJa: それ以上にあの影は放っておけない
findings.governingReading: Shirou says the shadow is an even greater priority than Zouken.
findings.explanation: The English turns the hierarchy into two parallel concerns.

findings.highlight: I confirm the plan with everyone
findings.evidenceJa: 異論はないな、と全員に確認する
findings.governingReading: Shirou asks everyone whether they have any objections.
findings.explanation: The English sounds as though collective agreement has already been confirmed, just before Sakura objects.

findings.evidenceJa: これは誰かの為じゃなくて
findings.governingReading: Shirou says the wish is not for someone else’s sake but is his own selfish wish.
findings.explanation: The English changes the altruism contrast into a denial of external coercion.

findings.evidenceJa: 刻印虫が取り除けるなら
findings.governingReading: Shirou speaks conditionally of removing the Crest Worms from Sakura’s body.
findings.explanation: The English changes the infestation from plural worms to one worm.

findings.evidenceJa: 代償はついて回る
findings.governingReading: Shirou distinguishes inevitable danger from the costs that accompany even a winnable fight.
findings.explanation: The English collapses cost or sacrifice into a repetition of physical risk.

findings.evidenceJa: 謝っているように見えた時
findings.governingReading: The narration ends on the moment when Sakura appeared to be apologizing, setting up Rin’s interruption.
findings.explanation: The English turns the conditional transition into a standalone observation and loses the sentence bridge.

findings.highlight: it does no good to whine
findings.evidenceJa: 今更どうこう言っても仕方がない
findings.governingReading: Rin says there is no point arguing or saying this and that now that the policy is settled.
findings.explanation: The English labels the emotional exchange as whining, adding contempt not stated by Rin.

findings.evidenceJa: 臓硯たちを見つけても
findings.governingReading: Rin says that if they find Zouken and his side, they must not initiate an attack rashly.
findings.explanation: The English narrows the enemy group to Zouken alone.

findings.evidenceJa: こっちも頼もしい
findings.governingReading: Shirou says Rin’s willingness makes matters reassuring or gives his side someone dependable.
findings.explanation: The English loses his explicit reliance on Rin.

findings.evidenceJa: その活動は大幅に抑えた筈よ
findings.governingReading: Rin says Kirei should have greatly suppressed the Crest Worms’ activity.
findings.explanation: The English removes both the large degree and Rin’s stated epistemic qualification.

findings.highlight: unless they use a drug on you
findings.evidenceJa: 直接何かをされないかぎり
findings.governingReading: Rin says another runaway episode requires some direct intervention like Shinji’s.
findings.explanation: The English invents a drug and makes the condition needlessly specific.

findings.evidenceJa: 臓硯は最後の一人にはなれない
findings.governingReading: Rin says Zouken cannot become the final remaining contender while Sakura stays protected in the house.
findings.explanation: The English replaces a concrete Grail War survival condition with the broader conclusion that he cannot win.

findings.evidenceJa: 刻印虫の暴走
findings.governingReading: Rin refers to the Crest Worms collectively running out of control.
findings.explanation: The English again recasts the plural infestation as a single entity.

findings.evidenceJa: 卑屈な考え
findings.governingReading: Rin condemns Sakura’s self-abasing, servile way of thinking.
findings.explanation: The English reduces an internalized posture of degradation to ordinary submissiveness.

findings.highlight: all the terrible things he’s done to you
findings.evidenceJa: あれだけ非道を重ねる奴
findings.governingReading: Rin points to Zouken’s accumulated inhuman atrocities as grounds for denying him human moral standing.
findings.explanation: The English narrows the charge to acts done specifically to Sakura.

findings.highlight: You have a hope of being saved
findings.evidenceJa: 貴女にだって助かる希望がある
findings.governingReading: Rin says that while Rider lives, even Sakura still has hope of being saved.
findings.explanation: The English loses the emphatic inclusion of Sakura against the apparent hopelessness of her case.

findings.highlight: Is it the dignity of the older sister?
findings.evidenceJa: さすが姉の貫禄というか
findings.governingReading: Shirou wryly recognizes Rin’s characteristic authority or presence as Sakura’s elder sister.
findings.explanation: The English turns his idiomatic appraisal into an awkward literal question.
